assumptions: Price-list workbook quantities are assigned to Limbe Store; Warehouse_September_2026.xlsx quantities are assigned to Limbe Warehouse.

Generic head-lamp, tail-lamp, and corner-lamp price-list quantities are total individual pieces. Even totals are split equally; an odd remainder is assigned to the left item and recorded in its source notes.
Warehouse left/right columns are used without alteration.

Corrected selling prices already verified in the existing source manifest are reused for the same price-list source rows. Warehouse items inherit a price only when a same-family description match scores at least 0.60; otherwise the price remains zero.

Eight wording-only duplicates with the same part type and vehicle fitment were consolidated into one product; branch quantities and all provenance references were summed and preserved. Fitment-sensitive year, generation, booster, transmission, colour, condition, and long/short variants remain separate.

Workbook rows do not confirm each product manufacturer or country of origin. All imported products remain assigned to the Unknown brand with no origin until a user confirms those fields; Dubai remains available only as a selectable country and on the optional Dubai brand records.
